translations.english: The place was adorned and made variegated by hundreds of cuckoos, king-bees, and birds of various colors, with mango trees serving as its prominent features.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाल में हनुमान जी ने जेसे जेसे कार्य किए, वैसे न तो इन्द्र, न विष्णु और न कुवेर ही कर सकते हैं
